content.short: Neurobro is an AI research agent for crypto and markets, with chat, portfolio and trading tools.
content.description: Neurobro is an AI agent for financial research that answers questions about crypto and markets, tracks whales and portfolios and surfaces trading signals. It is available on the web and mobile and as the Neurodex mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Neurobro is an AI crypto research agent, available as the Neurodex mini app in World App.
